dataset: Historical Lending Club loans issued from 2007 through 2014
generated_timestamp_note: Intentionally omitted so repeated exports from unchanged canonical inputs are byte-stable.
limitations: Historical Lending Club data with a status-based default proxy.
Educational portfolio project, not a production underwriting system.
LGD and EAD use documented simplifying assumptions.
Stress results are sensitivity scenarios rather than macroeconomic stress tests.
Portfolio default correlation is assumed, not empirically calibrated.
Under-seasoned vintages affect some observed outcomes.
methodology_disclaimer: Educational portfolio project; not a production underwriting, regulatory capital, IFRS 9, CECL, or lending-decision system.
project_description: Notebook-first Lending Club case study connecting calibrated probability of default to loss severity, exposure, portfolio risk, stress, simulation, and decisions.
project_title: Credit Risk and Portfolio Expected Loss Analytics
repository_version_scope: The commit identifies the last committed revision; the export may also include uncommitted local work.
